captions.detailed: This object is a pair of marine porro-prism binoculars with a dark, rubber-armored housing. It features two wide sealed objective barrels connected by a central revolute hinge, a central focus wheel, and a distinctive semi-spherical transparent compass housing mounted on top of the right barrel body. The central hinge allows the barrels to fold relative to each other, the center wheel rotates for focusing, and the compass assembly rotates on a revolute joint set into its mount.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a marine porro-prism binocular with rubber-armored barrels, a central revolute hinge, a center focus wheel, and a rotating compass housing with a transparent dome on the right barrel.
captions.factory: The code constructs the binocular by first defining shared materials (dark rubber, glass, and metal). It models the central hinge and focus wheel using cylindrical primitives aligned along the central axis. The left and right barrels are created with asymmetric offsets, combining lofted profiles or cylinders for the objective and eyepiece ends. A separate compass sub-assembly is built using a small cylinder for the bezel, a flat disk for the dial, and a transparent sphere segment for the dome, which is then attached to the right barrel with a revolute joint.
